# F - Reports

## When to Use
- Generating or reviewing financial reports
- Building executive summaries or dashboards
- Validating KPI consistency before publication

## Procedure
1. Understand data, audience, and communication objective.
2. Validate indicators against the Gold layer.
3. Structure narrative, charts, and executive summary.
4. Document assumptions and limitations.

## Standards
- Validate the data source before reporting a number.
- Use clear, executive-level language.
